115.why: Passes split B/D (both LOW). abcabc = abc x 1001 = abc x 7 x 11 x 13, so the number is always divisible by both 7 (B) and 11 (D). Defective as printed: two right options.
115.reasoning: A number like 357357 is 357 x 1000 + 357 = 357 x 1001. And 1001 = 7 x 11 x 13. So every number of this form is divisible by 7, by 11 and by 13. Here both 7 and 11 are among the options.
115.notice: Two options are correct: a number like 357357 equals 357 x 1001, and 1001 = 7 x 11 x 13, so it is always divisible by both 7 and 11. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.

123.why: As printed (2x+1)(x+m) = 2x^2 + (2m+1)x + m: the constant term gives m = -5, the x term gives m = -2 (not offered). 2x^2 - 3x - 5 actually factors as (2x-5)(x+1). Defective; B matches the constant term.
123.notice: This question is misprinted: 2x^2 - 3x - 5 = (2x - 5)(x + 1), so it has no factor (2x + 1). Matching the constant terms gives m = -5, option (2), but the x terms would need m = -2. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.
